name: Dionysius the Sophist
bio: Dionysius the Sophist is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 2nd century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book V: 81).

poems.title: Book V, 81
poems.author: Dionysius the Sophist
poems.text: You with the roses, rosy is your charm ; but what do you sell, yourself or the roses, or both?
